visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static shot of a light-colored mineral cluster, known as Hyalite, resting on a transparent pedestal against a solid black background. Top and bottom banners display the title of the series and mineral identification in Traditional Chinese. (2) The camera transitions to a macro close-up, revealing the intricate, bulbous texture of the crystal aggregates, which appear translucent and glassy under the steady, warm studio lighting. (3) Suddenly, the illumination switches to ultraviolet light, causing the entire specimen to emit a vibrant, saturated neon green glow that creates a high-contrast visual effect. (4) Further extreme close-up shots emphasize the intensity of the green fluorescence, with the light appearing to bloom and blur slightly due to its brightness against the dark setting. (5) The video concludes with a slow pan across the glowing mineral while final identification text and credits appear at the bottom, maintaining the clean, minimalist studio presentation throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as an educational showcase for a specific mineral specimen, Namibian Hyalite (Opal-AN). By combining high-quality macro visuals with professional narration, it highlights the mineral's unique physical structures and dramatic fluorescence under UV light to engage collectors and educational viewers.
